mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 2% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises > 10% in 1 month and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During an economic expansion, a decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases during an economic expansion and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
